import polars as pl
import re
from datetime import datetime
import math


def _parse_money(col: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        col.str.replace_all(r"[\$,]", "")
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2)
    )


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    debit_clean = _parse_money(raw["Debit"])
    credit_clean = _parse_money(raw["Credit"])

    amount_expr = pl.when(credit_clean.is_not_null()) \
        .then(credit_clean) \
        .otherwise(-debit_clean)

    return raw.select(
        account=pl.col("Account Number"),
        txn_date=pl.col("Transaction Date").str.to_date(format="%d %b %Y", strict=False),
        description=pl.col("Description"),
        amount=amount_expr,
        balance=_parse_money(pl.col("Balance")),
        reference=pl.col("Ref No"),
    )
